Name: Fluent Eating
Author: kangzoel161
Description:
[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Automatically consume the least selling value (energy/health per gold) consumable in inventory after reaching certain threshold.[/size]
[*][size=3]Maintain food and/or drink buff. [/size]
[*][size=3]Skip eating animation[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirement:[/b] [/size][b][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_SMAPI]SMAPI (^3.13.0)[/url][/b][size=4]
[/size][b]
[size=4]Configurable:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#e69138]Toggle Enabled: [/color][/b]keyboard binding to toggle the mod on and off[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#e69138]Health:[/color][/b][b] [/b]amount of health to start auto-eat[/size]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138][b][color=#e69138]Stamina[/color][/b]:[/color] amount of stamina to start auto-eat[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#e69138]Toggle Maintain Buff:[/color][/b] keyboard binding to toggle the maintain buff feature on and off[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#e69138]Maintain Buff:[/color][/b] maintain active buff of the most top-left food and/or drink (in backpack)[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#e69138]Skip Eating Animation:[/color][/b] well, as it says(?)[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Recommended Mod:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Bug Report:﻿[/b][/size]
[list]

[/list]

[list]

[list]
